title: Candidates
description: issues/<id>/library/candidates.json: what a worker found that might be fixed but is not decided yet. Written by the worker of a survey issue (its deliverable) or of a fix issue that stops on scope, through `andon issue candidates`, which checks it; never by hand. Rewritten whole each time and kept after finish. Read by the Chief of Staff, the person, triage and the retro; no gate or dispatcher decision reads it. Only these keys.

commit.description: The commit the worker looked at (HEAD when written): 40 lowercase hex digits. Required for an issue with a repository (the command checks it), absent for an issue without one.

candidates.description: One entry per thing that might be fixed. Empty when there is none (a survey issue still writes the file). ids are unique.

sha.description: A full git commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits.

id.description: Name used by question options, answers and briefs: c1, c2, ... Unique in the list.

text.description: What, where and how it would be fixed, one line.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root, as in findings.json: not empty, no control characters, not absolute, no .. segment.

in_scope.description: Inside the brief's scope (what to do and the completion condition). In a survey issue: whether it answers the question.
